name: Wallace
source:
It appears that Wallace says "Wall". He gives his love freely, and simply, how one might imagine a wall might. But I think there's more here than meets the lenses... like a prisoner with a smuggled nail file and a whole lotta patience, you too can slowly erode his armor and emerge on the other side of his personality.
Likes: Steadfastness, Trust
Dislikes: Small Children with Crayons
